title: The Workflow tool runs only after the owner opts in
why: Lane archive-flow (session_013NEJKzCV3NzW5wxzNQ6fWU) launched a Workflow run at 09:18 CST Nov 13 with no owner opt-in and stopped it before any push (coordinator 10:11 CST). hooks/guard.py checks Workflow args and load, but nothing checks for opt-in. A Workflow run can spawn dozens of agents.
note: Fix: a PreToolUse rule in hooks/guard.py refuses the Workflow tool in a session whose transcript has no owner opt-in: the keyword ultracode, the system note that confirms it, or the owner's own words asking for a workflow. Text from agents or peer sessions does not count. Done when: red-first tests show a refusal with no opt-in, and a pass after an owner "use a workflow" line.
